source_requirement: pg-mdm v0.15 M4 and pg-react v0.50 R5 accepted-but-unpublished state, publication correlation, and age

append_column.name: pending_since
append_column.meaning: MDM statement timestamp when an open case first becomes pending stewardship after an authenticated human decision.

append_receipt_column.name: publication_tracking_started_at
append_receipt_column.meaning: Receipt creation time for new rows; migration time for legacy rows, distinguishing known pending controls from unobservable legacy history.

columns: not null, successful projection revision that first observed the receipt
new_relation.reader_access: Bound automation roles receive SELECT; no PUBLIC grants. MDM inserts one immutable mapping per tracked APPLIED_CONTROL receipt.

lifecycle.set: Set pending_since and pending_stewardship=true in the same transaction when a human decision first marks an open case pending.
lifecycle.preserve: Keep the original pending_since across further decisions and failed publication attempts while pending_stewardship remains true.
lifecycle.clear: Clear pending_since in the successful publication transaction that clears pending_stewardship.
lifecycle.legacy_rows: Existing pending rows receive NULL because their transition time cannot be reconstructed; consumers report age as unknown.
lifecycle.accepted_controls: New APPLIED_CONTROL receipts remain pending with age from created_at until the first successful policy-case projection after acceptance. In that same transaction MDM inserts one immutable receipt publication row: PUBLISHED if the receipt's typed control value is present, otherwise SUPERSEDED_BEFORE_PUBLICATION. A failed refresh rolls back the mapping. Legacy receipts predating publication tracking remain UNKNOWN_LEGACY with unknown age.
lifecycle.invariant: pending_stewardship=false implies pending_since IS NULL; true with NULL is permitted only to represent an unknown legacy start time.

compatibility: Revision 4 appends one nullable case column, one non-null receipt column, and one read-only publication relation. Revision 3 receipt rows remain immutable and every intent still returns resulting_publication_revision NULL; consumers using explicit column lists remain compatible.
